login.title: Channel Omukwanaganya Okuyingira
login.welcome: Mwaniriziddwa okuddayo! Yingira okuddukanya okukulembera zo.
login.heroTitle: Kuza bizinensi yo ey’okutunda ettaka n’amayumba buli lw’oleeta
login.heroIntro: Omukutu gumu ogw’okuwandiisa bakasitoma mu bazimbi, okukuuma ebbanja ly’abakulembera n’okubagoberera okutuuka ku booking.

register.title: Wewandiise okukulembera mu sikonda
register.text: Waayo kasitoma wo ne pulojekiti gy’ayagala.

protect.title: Obukuumi obukoppa
protect.text: Lead yo esigala nga eyiyo okumala ekiseera ky’obukuumi, kale tewali muntu mulala asobola kwewozaako kasitoma y’omu.

track.title: Olondoole buli mutendera
track.text: Laba embeera ya buli lead n'ebyafaayo byonna, okuva ku kusooka okukwatagana okutuuka ku booking.

handover.title: Ebbanja ku booking
handover.text: Kasitoma bw’awandiika, omukulembeze akwasibwa omuzimbi ng’owandiise ng’omukwanaganya w’ensibuko.

login.secure: Okuyingira mu ngeri ey'obukuumi - ebikwata ku bakasitoma bo bisigala nga bya kyama

signup.title: Okuwandiisa abakolagana ne Channel
signup.intro: Tonda akawunti yo otandike okwewandiisa n'okuddukanya leads zo.
